implementation.discovery: The message menu receives only server-returned actions from active application installations and granted message-action scopes.
implementation.desktop: A nested Applications menu lists granted actions and presents an explicit disabled empty state instead of silently disappearing.
implementation.mobile: Long-press actions expose the same granted application actions.
implementation.execution: Invocation is persisted, tied to actor/server/channel/message, polled to a terminal result, and surfaces queued, success, failure, expiry or pending feedback. Revoked installations cannot complete a normal invocation.

remaining_acceptance: Install and revoke a real application in two clients, verify menu refresh, permission removal, bot completion and expiration against a running gateway.
